# railway_bucket (Data Source)

A bucket in a Railway environment, found by name. Use it to wire a bucket this configuration does not manage, such as one a `railway.go` file or the dashboard owns.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "railway_bucket" "assets" {
  environment_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  name           = "assets"
}

output "bucket_region" {
  value = jsondecode(data.railway_bucket.assets.config).config.region
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) ID of the environment that holds the bucket.
- `name` (String) Name of the bucket.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Graph address, such as `bucket.web`, for a resource's `variable_references`.
- `config` (String) The bucket's live graph node as JSON, in the shape `railway config plan` diffs, without variable values. Read fields with `jsondecode`.
- `id` (String) `<environment_id>/<address>`.
- `project_id` (String) ID of the project the environment belongs to.
- `railway_id` (String) Railway's ID for the bucket.
- `variable_names` (Set of String) Names of the variables set on the bucket.
